body: Up to 18 hours battery life is practically real; I easily get 14 to 15 hours of coding and browsing.
Silent fanless design with zero noise even during intensive tasks, totally silent in bed.
8GB RAM bottleneck with concurrent containers: Docker and Android Studio cause massive swap memory usage.
Blazing fast unified memory for creative workflows is true for light edits, but 8GB stutters when multitasking heavy IDEs.
